title: Config-impact sentinel & sandboxed golden snapshots for promptset change testing
creator: Maya Thompson
description:
Problem: Model/config rollouts sometimes cause subtle quality regressions tied to promptset behaviour (prefix caching, tokenization differences, or new quantization kernels). Existing eval gates run after rollouts on production traffic and require manual curation of golden snapshots, which slows rollbacks and increases customer exposure.

Goal: Build a lightweight, pre-rollout sentinel that: 1) creates an isolated sandbox of a target promptset (with exact prompt ordering and signer metadata), 2) automatically produces a signed immutable golden snapshot (content + manifest), and 3) executes a delta-focused regression suite comparing current baseline vs candidate model/config. Results should be surfaced in Console and block rollouts above configurable thresholds.

Scope and constraints: Sandbox must be permissioned (promptset stewards only), snapshots are immutable and signed (for audit), delta-evals should be quick (target < 12 minutes for 200 promptset samples), use incremental KV/fingerprint checks to avoid full re-eval when prompts unchanged, and integrate with existing CI/CD rollout hooks and Canary controller. Must support both hosted and Dedicated deployments (Private VPC later).

Design decisions to validate: Use signed manifests (Ed25519) stored in artifact-store with S3-compatible URIs, ephemeral reviewer tokens for cross-team access, and sentinel jobs executed in a low-latency runtime pool to mimic production kernels. We'll prefer deterministic sampling for the delta set to keep signal stable across runs.
acceptance_criteria: Sentinel job can create a sandboxed copy of any promptset referenced by a config change
Signed immutable snapshot (promptset + manifest) is uploaded to artifact-store with ed25519 signature and visible in Console
Delta-eval runner produces pass/fail with numeric regression delta and example failing prompts
Rollout pipeline can be blocked automatically when delta exceeds configured thresholds
RBAC: only promptset stewards and on-call SRE can trigger or revoke sentinel runs; reviewer tokens expire
Audit logs are recorded for snapshot creation, eval runs, and rollouts (with links to artifacts and PRs)
tasks: Define snapshot manifest schema and signing workflow (manifest fields: promptset_id, version, sampling_seed, signer, signature, created_at)
Implement sandbox copy API that clones prompt ordering and metadata without exposing underlying ACLs
Build delta-eval runner optimized for incremental checks (reuse cached embeddings/KV where applicable)
Wire sentinel as a pre-rollout hook in Canary controller and CI (Github PR + merge triggers)
Console UI: display snapshot artifact, numeric delta, top 10 failing prompts, and 'override with justification' flow
Implement ephemeral reviewer tokens and RBAC checks; integrate with SSO and audit logging
Create automated tests and a smoke job that runs against a synthetic model to validate timing SLA (< 12m for 200 samples)
Doc: Confluence runbook for promptset stewards and SREs, plus PRD notes for product counterparts
